primitives.label: Runneth
primitives.summary: Runneth as a whole: the runtime behind every surface.
productFeatures: The runtime behind every surface, carrying your workspace and org context into every conversation.
thingsToKnow: A model or provider outage hits every surface at once, so start here when several things break together.
It only sees the workspace it's in.

primitives.label: Runneth CLI (SSH)
primitives.summary: Manage Runneth VMs from your own machine over SSH.
productFeatures: A command-line tool that connects to a Runneth runtime over an OAuth-authorized SSH session, so you can work with a VM from your own machine.
Opens and reuses persistent shell sessions, sends commands, and manages multiple VM targets from one place.
Built for managing modules across VMs: installing them, handling updates and conflicts, and verifying installs.
thingsToKnow: Very early alpha, available to a small group only right now.
Access is tightly gated while broad-permission accounts and security guardrails are still being worked through.
External partners currently set it up from a packaged download until live distribution is locked down.
A native in-VM package installer is planned to replace the manual CLI path over time.

primitives.label: Brain
primitives.summary: What Runneth knows about your org.
productFeatures: Standing rules read on every message, plus saved files, templates, and skills matched when they're relevant.
thingsToKnow: Standing rules always apply, but saved files are matched, so a vaguely named file can get missed. Point Runneth at the right one if recall falls short.
The brain only covers this org.

primitives.label: Chat
primitives.summary: The Motion chat window and live conversation.
productFeatures: Starts and continues conversations, streams replies, and links out to the files, apps, and reports it builds.
thingsToKnow: A window glitch like a missing sidebar row or a first message that won't send is usually a display or startup hiccup, not lost data.
Startup and waking from idle can stall; a reload normally brings it back.

primitives.label: Conversation history
primitives.summary: How past chats are saved and found again.
productFeatures: Saves your web chats and Slack threads and finds past work by topic, person, date, or workspace.
thingsToKnow: The sidebar list isn't the full record. A conversation missing from the sidebar can still open from a direct link.
The newest messages lag slightly before they're searchable.

primitives.label: Integrations
primitives.summary: Connected tools, data access, and API keys.
productFeatures: Native sign-in (Slack, Google Drive, Notion), Motion data access, longer-tail apps through Pipedream, and stored API keys.
thingsToKnow: Native sign-in apps and Pipedream allow one connection per VM right now, with more on the way.
API-key tools can run several at once, each saved under its own name.

primitives.label: Slack
productFeatures: Reads channels and threads it's added to, posts replies and reports, and can create and set up a channel on request.
Tag it once and it stays in the thread.

channelTypes.label: Public channel
rules: Anyone in the workspace can add Runneth, or it adds itself when asked, and it can create and set up channels.
It reads full history in public channels it's added to, and can search public channels for context even ones it hasn't joined.

channelTypes.label: Private channel
rules: Someone already in the channel has to invite it; it can't add itself.
It only reads the private channels it's been invited to.

channelTypes.label: Direct message (Messages tab)
rules: Open Runneth from its Messages tab and it answers there.
It keeps DM history, so it deliberately ignores plain one-line DMs and can't start a DM first. For a private space, open a private channel and invite it in.

channelTypes.label: Group DM
rules: Not supported today; Slack blocks adding a bot to an existing group chat.

channelTypes.label: Slack Connect (external)
rules: External shared channels are treated like any channel it's added to.
Anyone in the external org can see its answers, so add it only where sharing your org's context outward is intended.

thingsToKnow: One Slack connection per VM right now, with more on the way.
Older threads can show messy formatting.
Older installs may need a Runneth-managed reconnect to pick up the narrower permission scope.

primitives.label: Google Drive
primitives.summary: Google Drive and Google file access.
productFeatures: Works with Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Google Calendar.
thingsToKnow: One Google connection per VM right now, with more on the way.
It only sees files you've shared with it. A file that won't open usually needs an access grant, not a full reconnect.

primitives.label: Notion
productFeatures: Reads and queries the Notion pages and databases shared with it.
thingsToKnow: One Notion connection per VM right now, with more on the way.
Pages have to be shared before it can read them. A brand-new page is invisible until access is granted.

primitives.label: Apps
primitives.summary: Openable pages and dashboards Runneth builds.
productFeatures: Openable pages for reports, dashboards, and previews, built on the files behind them.
thingsToKnow: Apps are private to the workspace that created them by default.
They show saved data refreshed on a schedule, so a number you just changed can lag.
OAuth-gated apps can show a rough logged-out screen.

primitives.label: Routines
productFeatures: Future, recurring, scheduled, or background work, including saving a routine plan now to set up later.
thingsToKnow: Reliable routine automation is still rolling out, so keep a human backstop on anything time-sensitive.
Slack-delivery routines are the newest and least proven piece.
Automation is temporarily paused during the current refactor.

primitives.label: Data access
primitives.summary: Motion data and connected data sources.
productFeatures: Own-account Meta performance, creatives, summaries, and transcripts; own-account TikTok performance and creative details; workspace goal, spend threshold, brand context, and metric and filter references.
Can rank by your saved goal, a specific metric, or a saved report.
thingsToKnow: Meta and TikTok are separate data paths.
Reports and Inspo aren't live yet (coming soon).
Pull-then-filter isn't the same as direct search and can be slower or less complete.
